name: hackshop
description: Operating guide and hosted MCP endpoint for agents helping a human build a physical Muse body: intake, plan, choose, shop with approval, assemble, flash and pair.

allowed_actions: Read public pages and agent files.
Call hosted MCP at https://www.hackshop.dev/mcp (stateless, POST only).
Call POST /api/plan for deterministic Muse planning (see /openapi.json).
Open outbound product, firmware and reference links for research.
Check out on a seller's site only after the human answers yes to "Place this order for $<total> at <seller>?".
disallowed_actions: Do not place any order without a clear yes to "Place this order for $<total> at <seller>?" for the exact items, sellers and total.
Do not try automated checkout on sites that don't allow it; give the human the link instead.
Do not type card numbers or passwords.
Do not flash a SenseCAP Watcher before backing up its nvsfactory partition; read the build plan's warnings first.
Do not activate controls tagged data-agent-danger without explicit confirmation.
Do not loop or retry rate-limited endpoints.
Do not expose real Muse SDK tokens; use mgst_YOUR_TOKEN as the placeholder in docs and code.
guardrails.purchase_policy: hackshop never buys anything. Your agent can help you buy the parts: it shows you the exact items, sellers and total, then asks "Place this order for $<total> at <seller>?" and waits for a clear yes before it checks out. If it can't check out on a site, or the site doesn't allow automated checkout (Amazon and eBay don't), it gives you the link to buy yourself.
